subject.title: fix: prevent session exports from writing outside workspace

question: Should complete HTML session export adopt the same owner-only boundary as trajectory export?
rationale: Workspace confinement is clearly required, but removing existing authorized non-owner export access is a permanent security and compatibility policy choice that code review cannot decide alone.

options.title: Match trajectory export
options.body: Make session export owner-only and workspace-confined because it contains transcripts, system prompts, and tool schemas.

options.title: Confinement only
options.body: Preserve authorized non-owner session exports while rejecting every destination outside the workspace.

recommendation.title: Match trajectory export
recommendation.body: Make session export owner-only and workspace-confined because it contains transcripts, system prompts, and tool schemas.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the adjacent trajectory-export owner gate and have recent least-privilege Gateway boundary history.
